# University of Nottingham

> A globally-ranked research university offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and apprenticeship programs across three UK campuses with comprehensive student support and facilities.

The University of Nottingham is a leading UK institution known for research excellence (REF2021), sustainable development initiatives, and international student recruitment. The site provides detailed information for prospective and current students across multiple study pathways, campuses, and support services.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Study
- Postgraduate Study
- Master's Degrees
- PhD Programs
- Degree Apprenticeships
- International Students
- Campus Facilities
- Student Accommodation
- Fees and Funding
- Scholarships and Bursaries
- Student Experience
- Open Days
- Three Campuses (University Park, Jubilee, Sutton Bonington)
- QS World University Rankings
- Sustainable Development

## Study Options & Admissions

- [Study with us](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/study-with-us.aspx): Main study portal covering undergraduate, postgraduate, apprenticeships, and online learning options
- [Postgraduate study](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy): Postgraduate study hub with Master's, PhD, and doctoral training programme information
- [Find Your Nottingham](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/ugstudy/find-uon.html): Personalized questionnaire guide for undergraduate study options across three campuses
- [Degree Apprenticeships](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/workingwithbusiness/services/degree-apprenticeships.aspx): Degree apprenticeship programs for employer partnerships and workforce development
- [Clearing](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/ugstudy/clearing/clearing.aspx): UCAS clearing process information for undergraduate applicants without offers

## International & Applicant Support

- [Information for international applicants](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/index.aspx): Guidance for international students on fees, funding, visas, and country-specific information
- [Fees and funding](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/what-next/fees-and-funding.aspx): Tuition fees, loans, scholarships, and financial support options for all student types
- [Open Days](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/open-days): Open day event booking and virtual campus tours across three Nottingham campuses
- [Virtual Nottingham](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/virtualnottingham/index.aspx): 360-degree virtual campus exploration tool for prospective students
- [Help and support](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/help-and-support/home.html): Help hub with FAQs, guidance, and chatbot support for admissions and student queries

## Student Life & Experience

- [Accommodation](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/student-living/accommodation/index.aspx): Halls of residence, accommodation options, and residential experience information
- [Life on campus](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/student-experience/life-on-campus.aspx): Campus activities, student union, clubs, societies, and social spaces guide
- [Student Services](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studentservices): Student services hub for registration, fees, wellbeing, and disability support
- [UoNSU Societies](https://su.nottingham.ac.uk/societies): Student union societies, clubs, and community involvement opportunities
- [Community Engagement](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/currentstudents/yourcommunity/living-in-the-community/livinginthecommunity.aspx): Student housing, community engagement, and residential life guidance

## Campus & Facilities

- [Facilities](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/about/facilities/facilities.aspx): Overview of campus facilities including sports, libraries, arts, and health centers
- [Libraries](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/library): Library services, collections, study spaces, and academic support resources

## About the University

- [University of Nottingham Homepage](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk): University of Nottingham homepage with rankings, research power, and sustainable development initiatives
- [About the University](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/about): Institutional overview with history, governance, rankings, and global campus information
